correctness.rationale: Strongly convex objective has KKT multipliers and continuous piecewise-affine proximal map. Because second-difference D is surjective, every zero-curvature active-row subset F occurs on an open strictly complementary stratum (choose z0 with prescribed zero/nonzero D z0, multipliers 0 on F and sign 1 elsewhere). Jacobian is the constant-preserving orthogonal projector P_F. Any input difference decomposes into a constant plus one-jump vectors; the V seminorm operator norm of P_F is max_j V(P_F c^j). Integrate local derivatives along line segments to bound globally and realize each maximizing norm locally, proving equality for all n and lambda>0. Rational exhaustive enumeration for all faces and jumps at n=2..8 reproduced independently in a SymPy implementation, including 4-site exact 6/5 KKT witness; affine least-squares step slope 6j(n-j)/(n(n^2-1)) analytically gives universal bound and asymptotic >=3/2.
